content_sections.heading: NCST Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. 20025/66/2024-NCST (e-29322) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NCST notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers of Central/State Governments, Union Territories, autonomous or statutory organisations, PSUs, universities or recognised research institutions; Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or Department; or two years' regular service in Level-9 (Rs.53100-167800/-) or equivalent; or four years' regular service in Level-8 (Rs.47600-151100/-) or equivalent; Masters Degree in Computer Applications or Information Technology or Computer Science or Software Engineering from a recognised University or Institute; OR Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology in Computer Engineering or Computer Science or Computer Technology or Computer Science and Engineering or Software Engineering or Information Technology or Electronics Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering from a recognised University or Institute Experience: Three years experience in electronic data processing or computer programming or software development or data base management system or web designing or networking or organising computerised information storage and retrieval system or data security Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Open only to officers of Central/State Governments, UTs, autonomous or statutory organisations, PSUs, universities or recognised research institutions

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NCST Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Officers whose services cannot be spared immediately on selection

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay regulated in accordance with DoPT O.M No. 6/8/2008-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010 as amended from time to time. Deputation for three (3) years initially, which can be curtailed or extended depending on requirement, with officer's consent and lending department's approval Period of deputation, including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation in Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed three years Usual deputation terms apply

content_sections.heading: How Will NCST Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Appointment on deputation basis from eligible and willing officers under Central/State Governments, UTs, autonomous bodies, PSUs, universities or research institutions

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the Annexure proforma Attested photocopies of complete APARs for the last five (5) years Vigilance clearance Separate integrity certificate Statement of major/minor penalties imposed, if any, during the last 10 years Certificate signed by Head of Department/Authorised Signatory of parent office

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCST Recruitment 2027 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the proforma given in the Annexure of the notice. Forward it through proper channel by e-mail to [email protected] and [email protected] . Attach attested photocopies of complete APARs for the last five years, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate and statement of major/minor penalties of the last 10 years. Send the hard copy with all signed documents by post to Sh. Tajinder Singh Bal, Under Secretary, NCST Section, Ministry of Tribal Affairs, New Delhi- 110001. Hard copy should reach before the last date of receipt of applications. Email it on or before 11 January 2027.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: An officer once selected will not be allowed to withdraw candidature Applications received after the last date or incomplete in any manner will not be considered Applications not accompanied by all requisite documents will not be entertained Contact: Sh. Tajinder Singh Bal, Telephone 011- 23343708

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCST Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCST Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Assistant Director (Programming).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NCST Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 11 January 2027. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level 10 of Pay Matrix (Rs.56100-177500).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Masters Degree in Computer Applications / Information Technology / Computer Science / Software Engineering, OR B.E./B.Tech in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Technology, Computer Science and Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics Engineering or Electronics and Communication Engineering; and three years experience in EDP, programming, software development, DBMS, web designing, networking, information storage and retrieval or data security; plus a.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to officers of Central/State Governments, UTs, autonomous or statutory organisations, PSUs, universities or recognised research institutions.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers whose services cannot be spared immediately on selection.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on deputation basis from eligible and willing officers under Central/State Governments, UTs, autonomous bodies, PSUs, universities or research institutions.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation for three (3) years initially, which can be curtailed or extended depending on requirement, with officer's consent and lending department's approval. Period of deputation, including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation in Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Usual deputation terms apply.
